content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-92. - Violations and penalties.
content.summary:
Any person violating any of the provisions of this article shall, upon conviction
               thereof, be punished by a fine not to exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 1, 8-29-2016
)
